title: CrystalCombatLog
description: Prevents combat logging by automatically penalizing players who leave the server while in a fight.
body:
# ⚔️ CrystalCombatLog ⚔️

**CrystalCombatLog** is a lightweight, essential server-side Fabric mod designed to prevent players from escaping PvP battles by disconnecting. Ensure fair fights on your server with automatic punishments and clear visual warnings! 🛡️

## ✨ Features
* **⚠️ Visual Warnings:** Displays a clear bossbar timer at the top of the screen when a player enters combat.
* **💬 Chat Notifications:** Sends a direct warning message in the chat telling players not to leave the game.
* **☠️ Automatic Punishment:** If a player disconnects while the combat timer is active, they are automatically penalized to prevent unfair escapes.
* **⚡ Server-Side Only:** Completely server-side! Players do not need to install this mod on their clients. Just drop it into your server's `mods` folder.

## ⚙️ Technical Details
* **Loader:** Fabric
* **Minecraft Version:** 26.1.2
* **Environment:** Required on Server / Unsupported on Client

*Perfect for SMPs, Anarchy, and any PvP-focused servers!* 🎮
